item.title: 4 ways to cope with constant thoughts about your body image
item.description: Obsessing over your looks should not take up all your energy, says psychologist Diana Hill. If you're struggling with uncomfortable thoughts about your body, ground yourself with these techniques.

item.description: Amid a record-setting outbreak of the diarrhea-causing parasite, food safety advocates say risks to food production are increasing.

item.title: FDA approves landmark pancreatic cancer drug that's shown to improve survival
item.description: U.S. health officials have approved a groundbreaking pancreatic cancer drug that offers a new approach to treating the deadly form of cancer, by blocking a protein that fuels tumor growth in the vast majority of cases.

item.title: Drugstores say Medicare's $50 obesity drug program is catching on
item.description: The Bridge program, which began July 1, makes some Medicare beneficiaries eligible for obesity drugs for $50 a month. CVS and Walgreens say they've each already filled 100,000 such prescriptions.

item.description: Recalls of lettuce, jalapeno peppers and eggs because of foodborne illness outbreaks have put a spotlight on the safety of the U.S. food supply. How much do the recalls tell us?

item.title: Kids with brain injuries thrive at this camp. But federal research funding is in flux
item.description: A Pennsylvania summer camp helps children who have survived brain injuries. But the future of federal funding for brain injury research, as well as grants to states to help such patients, is in limbo.
